company: Bench Excavation and Civil Construction Pty Ltd (BenchHDC)
relocation_line: I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi BenchHDC team,

My name's Marc, and I'm looking for a graduate engineer role. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and back in 2019 I finished a civil engineering degree in the Philippines. Your Port Adelaide job comes with full training in directional drilling, so I'd like to apply.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on two building sites in the Philippines. On the first I coordinated a crew of 10 to 15 each day and kept the client up to date. These days I work casually at a bp service station in Melbourne.

I'm happy to move to Adelaide and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a White Card. Thanks for reading, and I hope to talk soon.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
